rule.statement: An order directing the defendants to execute a deed of transfer conveying Lot no. 4 to the plaintiff is a nullity.
rule.supporting_quote: That Order was unnecessary and irrelevant since Weerasuriya has never had title to Lot no. 4, as set out earlier in this judgment. In any event, the learned District Judge himself has held that the plaintiff has title to Lot no. 4 and is entitled to an order for ejectment of the 1st and 2nd defendants from Lot no. 4 [“ඒ අනුව පමිනිලිකාරිය මෙෙ න්‍ඩුවට අදාල ඉඩමේ අයිතිකාරිය බව තීරණය කරන්‍ අතර අදාල 1,2 විත්තතිකරුවන් සහ අනිකුත්ත අය මෙෙ න්‍ඩුවට අදාල ඉඩමෙන් මන්‍රපීෙට නිමයෝග කරමි.”].
